links.outcome: Accuracy, AUROC, precision and recall of EAC+ versus standard practice, EAC thresholds, logistic regression, decision tree
links.effect: EAC+ achieved the highest accuracy (91.4%), AUROC (0.94), precision (0.89), and recall (0.92) versus comparators; also shortened ICU stay by 1.6 days and lowered 30-day mortality.
links.quote: EAC+ achieved the highest accuracy (91.4%), AUROC (0.94), precision (0.89), and recall (0.92), while reducing unnecessary surgical delays, shortening ICU stay by an average of 1.6 days, and lowering 30-day mortality.

links.outcome: Multisite prospective validation across five Level 1 trauma centres
links.effect: Prospective multicentre evaluation in 3,512 patients across five Level 1 trauma centres; results reported as validated across centres, without per-site breakdown in the text.
links.quote: Involving 3,512 patients across five Level 1 trauma centres, the algorithm was benchmarked against standard practice, original EAC thresholds, logistic regression, and decision tree models.

screen.reason: Prospective pragmatic multicentre trial evaluating a real-time explainable AI clinical decision support system (EAC+) embedded in trauma workflow against standard practice and traditional static protocols, assessing clinical outcomes like ICU stay and mortality.

primary.practice: real-time dynamic CDS alerts vs standard static protocols
